
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/blue-smile/p/23664549" title="发布于 2026-11-14 13:41">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">APP测试相关的adb常用命令</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>一、设备连接与基础</p>
<p>adb devices # 查看已连接设备<br>adb install -r xxx.apk               # 安装（-r 覆盖升级，-t 允许测试包）<br>adb uninstall com.xxx                # 卸载<br>adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release   # 安卓版本<br>adb shell wm size                    # 屏幕分辨率<br>adb reboot / adb reboot recovery     # 重启 / 进 recovery</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>二、App 性能与状态</p>
<p>adb shell dumpsys activity top | findstr "ACTIVITY"&nbsp; &nbsp;# 当前前台 Activity</p>
<p>adb shell dumpsys meminfo com.xxx&nbsp; &nbsp; # 内存占用（观察泄漏/峰值）</p>
<p>adb shell top -n 1 | findstr com.xxx # CPU 占用快照</p>
<p>adb shell dumpsys battery&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 电量（耗电测试）</p>
<p>adb shell dumpsys network | findstr com.xxx&nbsp; # App 流量</p>
<p>adb shell screencap /sdcard/s.png &amp;&amp; adb pull /sdcard/s.png&nbsp; &nbsp;# 截图拉到电脑</p>
<p>adb shell screenrecord /sdcard/r.mp4 # 录屏（Ctrl+C 结束）</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>三、调试与抓包辅助</p>
<div>
<div>adb shell settings put global http_proxy 172.xx.xx.xx:8888&nbsp; &nbsp;# 全局代理（指向 Charles）</div>
<div>adb shell settings put global http_proxy :0&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 取消代理（抓不到包先执行这个排障）</div>
<div>adb forward tcp:8080 tcp:8080&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 端口转发（调试本地服务）</div>
<div>adb shell netstat | findstr 443&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 查 App 的 443 连接状态</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>四、文件传输</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>adb push 本地文件 /sdcard/&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 电脑 → 手机</div>
<div>adb pull /sdcard/log.txt 本地路径&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# 手机 → 电脑</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>五、系统级操作（root 设备可用的一部分）</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>adb root&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;# adbd 提权（工程机/模拟器）</div>
<div>adb remount&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # /system 可写（改 hosts 抓包常用）</div>
<div>adb logcat -c&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 清空旧日志（复现 bug 前先清）</div>
<div>adb bugreport&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 完整问题报告 zip（提重型 bug 用）</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>六、查 SSL/握手错误</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div># 实时日志过滤 SSL 相关（Windows 用 findstr，Mac/Linux 用 grep）</div>
<div>adb logcat | findstr /i "ssl sslhandshake pinning trustmaster cert"</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div># 只看 App 自己的日志：先拿 PID，再过滤</div>
<div>adb shell pidof com.laiyifen.xxx&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 换成实际包名</div>
<div>adb logcat --pid=&lt;上面拿到的PID&gt;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div># 更省事：Android 8.0+ 只看某 App</div>
<div>adb logcat | findstr "包名"</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
